title: Plugin request, contract v0
description: What a gateway writes to a plugin's stdin: one JSON object. The plugin reads nothing else: no files, no environment, no secrets. It opens a connection only to a host listed in network.hosts, and to none at all when network.replay is given.

contract.description: The contract version of this request. A plugin that does not speak it answers with exit code 3.

caps.description: Set by the caller. The plugin finishes within timeSeconds and writes at most outputBytes; the caller kills it after timeSeconds and refuses a larger output.

network.description: Absent: no network at all. hosts: the only hosts the plugin may connect to. replay: recorded responses that stand in for the network, with a virtual clock, for conformance runs; the plugin then opens no connection and does not really wait.

start.description: The virtual clock's start; waits advance it instead of passing

exchanges.description: url to its responses, answered in order; a request for a URL with no response left gets a network error

input.description: The verb's input; its schema depends on the job named by describe (fact-refresh.schema.json for the fact-refresh job).

error.description: Instead of a response: the request fails with this network error.
